lifecycle: one fresh Python process per seed/arm
order: all/parameters on even seed positions, reversed on odd positions
confirmation: two adjacent passing snapshots; no interpolation; report non-confirmations and left censoring
timing: snapshot timestamps include previous snapshot I/O, exclude later analytical evaluation; warm prediction is eager control, not deployment executor
analysis: quality and independent physical residual at each snapshot
training wall time, closure counts, peak memory, independent-control prediction cost
limitations: New preregistered protocol, not a reinterpretation of the previous negative seed19 result. More snapshots and an increased common L-BFGS budget of 200 instead of 150. No threshold changes after outcomes. No analytic teacher or early stopping. All ten trials use one pinned revision.
